in_line.signal_detail_en: A/H premium 29.2% (z +0.00 vs 1y history); CSI 300 price z -1.87
in_line.thesis: A/H premium z vs CSI 300 price z — a two-leg pair. Premium widening (A-shares bid vs H) while CSI 300 price z is lagging its own history suggests onshore-relative demand has not yet been confirmed by price. Fires only when both legs disagree and |z| >= 1.0. DATA NOTE: premium embeds USDCNY/USDHKD FX, not FX-stripped. Direction unproven — accruing as Phase-0 candidate.

in_line.signal_detail_en: Offshore (KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ) 5d equal-weight ret gap vs CSI300: +1.61% (z +0.78); FX-adj gap +1.7% (CNY -0.13%). FX note: gap embeds USDCNY moves — see FX-adj if available. Composition note: basket is tech/internet-tilted (KWEB=internet, CQQQ=tech-heavy) vs CSI 300's financials tilt — gap partly reflects sector rotation, not pure venue sentiment.
in_line.signal_detail_zh: 离岸ETF(KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ) 5日等权收益差 vs 沪深300: +1.61%（z +0.78）；汇率调整后差价 +1.7%（人民币 -0.13%）。注：差值包含人民币汇率影响；篮子偏科技/互联网，与沪深300金融偏重有差异。
in_line.thesis: Offshore China ETF basket (KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ — US-listed offshore listings; ASHR/GXC excluded as they hold A-shares directly) total-return equal-weight gap vs CSI 300. A strongly positive gap (offshore outperforming) while onshore lags = offshore sentiment leading. FX caveat: gap embeds USDCNY. Composition note: basket is tech/internet-tilted (KWEB=internet, CQQQ=tech-heavy) vs CSI 300's financials tilt — gap partly reflects sector rotation, not pure venue sentiment. Hypothesis: sustained offshore leadership tends to attract onshore catch-up over ~3 months.
